grasp_0.description: this grasp point is located on the handle of the brush

plane_0.description: The plane is a vertial plane for the front of the brush. Its normal is aligned with the handle of the brush, from the handle of the brush to the head of the brush. This plane can be used to denote the orientation of the brush. When sweeping with brush, the normal direction of this plane should vertical to the moving direction.

plane_1.description: The second plane is a horizontal plane defined by the brush head. Its centroid is positioned at the geometric center of the brush head surface, and can be used to denote the sweep plane when sweeping the table with the brush.
